top_stories.title: A precision T-cell therapy stalls treatment-resistant cancers in clinical trial
top_stories.description: Experimental drug invika halts progression of refractory tumors by selectively stimulating tumor-fighting T cells.

top_stories.title: Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations
top_stories.description: Anthropic is the first major AI lab to file an S-1 with the SEC, planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT." The numbers are strong, with $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue, a first-ever operating profit, and existing customers spending nine times more year over year. But the company also carries roughly $800 billion in long-term compute commitments. The article Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations appeared first on The Decoder.
